pages.text: The thoughts of someone right before joining the Risus - materialized between the roots of a bonded tree. $(br2)I'm... so sorry, my children. I wasn't a good enough mother for you all. I-I tried everything I could. But I wasn't enough for you all. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. If only I was better, maybe I could have healed you all. You wouldn't be just laying here then... I hope

- no, I pray that in the next life, you will all be happier. Maybe even with me, all of us together, living like a big family once more. I-I would like that... And if I can't join you, I pray that you all receive better parents than I ever was... Please, just please don't hate me for not being better. I- I'm... $(br2)The Dead Mother of the World answered the request of the anxious.
